title: WelcomeMessage
description: Runtime to client: the reply to an accepted hello (SPEC.md section 5).

version.description: The version both sides use from now on: the hello's major version with the lower of the two minor versions.

role.description: The role granted, the one the hello asked for.

client_id.description: Name the runtime gives this connection in its logs.

runtime.description: The rig runtime program and its version.

heartbeat_ms.description: Heartbeat interval: each side sends a heartbeat on a timer of this period (SPEC.md section 6).

watchdog_ms.description: The runtime's watchdog acts when no heartbeat from the motion client has arrived for longer than this (ADR-0002, Rig runtime).

epoch.description: The epoch the client starts with: 0 for a new session.

session.description: The current session, if one is configured. Required for role motion.

world.description: The world the session starts in (phase 1: its only world). Required for role motion.

device.description: The motion device and the guarantees its samples carry. Required for role motion.
